marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to east 15 knots this evening then backing
to north 20 Monday afternoon. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2
Monday morning and to 2 to 3 Monday evening.<br/>
